```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David"],
    "spend": [1500, 800, 2000, 950]
}
df_pd = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_pd)

# Add tier column with conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then(nw.lit("gold")).otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Convert back to native
result = df.to_native()
print(result)
```
